description: Implement RFC 9670 (JMAP Sharing) data types. Types only — no async, no network. Structs: Principal (id, type, name, description, email, timeZone, capabilities, accounts, isActive), PrincipalType enum (individual/group/resource/location/other), ShareNotification (id, created, changedBy, objectType, objectAccountId, objectId, oldRights, newRights), ChangedBy (name, email, principal), filter/condition types for both, PrincipalsCapability, PrincipalsOwnerCapability. All fields camelCase serde. Spec: RFC 9670. Pattern: follow jmap-mail-types or jmap-chat-types exactly.
title: jmap-sharing-types: RFC 9670 data types
